mostWorthwhile.text: The grazing impact and subsequent gathering of orbiting rubble were most worthwhile: they made the moon's origin clear and connected two different collision outcomes.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the molten world was less rewarding because it only listed partners; I still had to choose which collision to try.

surprise.text: The first large impact melted the world's interior rather than immediately producing the moon-forming debris I expected.

arbitrary.text: The initial pebble-and-small-body pairing felt unclear: it failed, though the compatibility feedback automatically combined the pebbles with fragments instead.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the contrasting effects of gentle and violent collisions made the material's changing history interesting.
